Product specification schema

Source: R/product-schema.R
product_schema.Rd

Supply product specification fields to product, combine rows with products, or check an existing data frame with validate_products.

Details

Each row is one product. Required means there is no default. Omitted optional fields take the default shown.

Explicit missing values are accepted only where stated. Numeric fields accept integer or double input. Whole-number fields reject fractional values.

Logical fields also accept numeric zero and one. Factors are converted for character fields. Bounds use the stated endpoint convention.

Equality of an inclusive lower and exclusive upper bound leaves no eligible entry value.

Length means feet with imperial calls and meters with metric calls. Diameter means inches or centimeters. Product definitions initially normalize lengths to the nearest inch, with halves upward, and retain the original supplied values.

Merchandising normalizes those values to one inch or 0.0254 meter under the selected units. Preserve product attributes so metric calls use the original specifications. Selecting metric units does not convert measurements supplied in feet or inches.

Board-foot procedures still measure in inches and feet.

Tree entry requires the relevant species, age, and pruning measurements. Missing required attributes can produce missing_product_attribute. Diameter at breast height limits choose the entry product.

Later use requires allow_after_higher_product and still checks species, age, and pruning. Log diameters are tested at the physical endpoints, including trim at the small end. A missing optional upper limit imposes no limit, not a zero limit.

Tree eligibility

FieldMeaningTypeUnitDefaultConstraints
productProduct labelCharacterNoneRequiredNonempty, nonmissing, unique across rows. Example: 'saw'.
priorityOrder consideredIntegerNoneRequiredPositive, nonmissing, unique. Smaller values first.
speciesAccepted speciesCharacterNone'all''all', 'softwood', 'hardwood', or 'spcd(202,263)'. Numeric codes and recognized names are resolved by product(). Missing and unresolved selections are errors.
min_dbhMinimum entry diameterNumericDiameter0Inclusive bound on outside-bark diameter at breast height. Nonnegative and finite. Missing is an error.
max_dbhUpper entry diameterNumericDiameterNAExclusive bound on outside-bark diameter at breast height. Nonnegative and finite. Missing means no upper bound. Must be at least min_dbh.
min_ageMinimum tree ageNumericYearsNAInclusive bound. Nonnegative and finite when supplied. Missing means no bound. Upper must be at least lower. Use the inventory age convention.
max_ageUpper tree ageNumericYearsNAExclusive bound. Nonnegative and finite when supplied. Missing means no bound. Upper must be at least lower. Use the inventory age convention.
prunedRequired pruning stateLogicalNoneNATRUE or FALSE. Missing means either state. No pruning height is inferred.
allow_after_higher_productAllow use after an earlier productLogicalNoneTRUENonmissing. Diameter at breast height limits apply to entry, not later use. Species, age, and pruning still apply.
accepts_pulp_restrictionAccept wood restricted to pulpLogicalNoneFALSENonmissing. At most one product may be TRUE. Applies within pulp intervals and above forks.

Lengths

FieldMeaningTypeUnitDefaultConstraints
lengthsDiscrete nominal lengthsNumeric vector in list cellLengthNULLNonempty finite nonnegative values, each positive after normalization. Sorted and deduplicated. Range fields must be missing. A data-frame cell is I(list(c(16, 20))).
min_lengthShortest ordinary range lengthNumericLengthNARequired when lengths is NULL. Finite, nonnegative, positive after normalization. Inclusive.
max_lengthLongest ordinary range lengthNumericLengthNAMissing means no product upper limit. Otherwise finite, nonnegative, and at least normalized min_length. Inclusive.
length_stepIncrement in the length rangeNumericLengthNARequired when lengths is NULL. Finite, nonnegative, positive after normalization. Lengths start at min_length and advance by this increment.
trimExtra length beyond nominal endNumericLength0Finite, nonnegative, nonmissing. The physical length equals nominal length plus trim.
min_boundary_lengthShortest additional boundary logNumericLengthNAMissing disables boundary logs. Use a positive finite length. Values that normalize to zero are rejected. Negative and infinite values are rejected. Allows logs ending at eligible boundaries, including defect limits and diameter crossings.
max_logs_per_segmentLimit per product in each usable sectionIntegerLogsNAMissing means unlimited. Otherwise 1 through 1000 inclusive. Counts restart above cull sections.
allow_lower_productsPermit progression to later productsLogicalNoneTRUENonmissing. FALSE ends the reachable product sequence at this product.

Diameters

FieldMeaningTypeUnitDefaultConstraints
min_sedMinimum physical small endNumericDiameterRequiredFinite and nonnegative when supplied. Inclusive. Missing is an error.
max_sedMaximum physical small endNumericDiameterNAFinite and nonnegative when supplied. Inclusive. Missing means no upper bound. Must be at least min_sed.
min_ledMinimum large end at log startNumericDiameter0Finite and nonnegative when supplied. Inclusive. Missing is an error.
max_ledMaximum large end at log startNumericDiameterNAFinite and nonnegative when supplied. Inclusive. Missing means no upper bound. Must be at least min_led.

Defect limits

FieldMeaningTypeUnitDefaultConstraints
max_sweepMaximum sweep categoryCharacterNoneNAMissing means no category limit. Otherwise nonempty and present in curvature_scale. Categories up to the maximum are accepted. No volume deduction is inferred.
max_crookMaximum crook categoryCharacterNoneNAMissing means no category limit. Otherwise nonempty and present in curvature_scale. Categories up to the maximum are accepted. No volume deduction is inferred.
max_rot_pctMaximum located rot deductionNumericPercentNAMissing means no limit. Otherwise 0 through 100 inclusive. The log percentage is weighted by physical inside-bark volume. Equal to the maximum is accepted.

Measurement and price

FieldMeaningTypeUnitDefaultConstraints
volume_unitMeasurement unitCharacterNamed unitRequiredscribner, international, doyle, cubic, green_ton, or cord.
inside_barkBark basis for diameter limits and cubic volumeLogicalNoneTRUENonmissing TRUE or FALSE. Board foot rules and weight keep their prescribed measurement basis.
split_scaleSplit Scribner scaling sectionsLogicalNoneFALSENonmissing TRUE or FALSE. No measurement effect for other units.
roundScaling diameter preprocessingCharacterWhole inchesdefaultdefault, down, nearest, or none. See Scaling rules.
cord_solid_fractionSolid fraction of stacked cordNumericFractionNARequired only for cord products, strictly greater than zero and less than one. Must be missing for every other procedure.
priceQuote for the stated quantityNumericCurrency per quoteNAMissing means unpriced. Otherwise finite and nonnegative. All priced products in a run require one currency label.
price_perQuantity covered by one quoteNumericMeasurement unit1Finite, strictly positive, nonmissing.

Provenance

FieldMeaningTypeUnitDefaultConstraints
specification_sourceSource of the specificationCharacterNoneNAOptional note. Missing means no source recorded. Does not certify the specification.
meta_*Additional descriptive columnsCaller suppliedCaller definedAbsentRetained without changing calculations. Supply matching columns when combining products. Example: meta_grade = 'illustrative'.

Compatibility

Former fields are accepted for migration with deprecation messages. fallback, pulp_product, max_defect_pct, price_quantity, and source_id map to allow_after_higher_product, accepts_pulp_restriction, max_rot_pct, price_per, and specification_source. grade becomes meta_grade.

The package does not assign grades. min_top_length, continue_to_top, and max_pieces map to min_boundary_length, allow_lower_products, and max_logs_per_segment.

The former sold_by and diameter_basis fields map to the measurement fields described in Scaling rules. The former rounding columns are accepted only in additional reporting definitions. length_parity is translated into explicit lengths or a range.

segmentation_policy belongs to products_from_nvel_rules and the recorded source settings, not an authored specification.

Status and missing values

Invalid specifications stop the call. The checked table has no calculation status codes. A valid specification does not guarantee volume.

See Result tables for statuses and missing result quantities.

Value

A specification defines the columns of a merch_products data frame. Field types and units are listed above.

See also

product for one specification, Scaling rules for scaling procedures, and defect for recorded restrictions.

Examples

## Load dplyr
library(dplyr)

## Inspect example product fields
example_products(name = 'pnw') %>%
  select(product, min_sed, trim, volume_unit)
#> <products> 3 product(s)
#>       product min_sed trim volume_unit
#>        export      12  1.0    scribner
#>  domestic_saw       6  1.0    scribner
#>          pulp       3  0.5   green_ton
